attempts.summary: Published node2's HTTP service (bootstrapped busybox-extras httpd on :8080, bound to node2's private-network address, persisted via OpenRC) through node1 (OpenWrt) via a firewall DNAT redirect (port 80 -> 10.100.29.11:8080) plus a hairpin SNAT rule, so node3 can reach the service at node1's management address on port 80 while the service stays on the private network. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change and post-restart service/config recovery verified on each.
